legal.draftText: This text is a working draft, not final legal wording. Anything in [square brackets] is still to be filled in. Do not rely on it until it has been reviewed.

service.title: What Tattoo Trainer is
service.p1: Tattoo Trainer is a practice tool for beginner tattoo artists. You pick a cartridge, an ink cap and a machine speed, transfer a sketch onto a sheet of virtual practice skin as a stencil, tattoo it, and get feedback on how closely you followed it.
service.p2: It is a simulation. Real skin, real machines and real ink behave differently.

noQualification.title: No qualification
noQualification.p1: Using the trainer does not give you any qualification, licence, certificate or permission to tattoo. Scores and feedback are for practice only and are not an assessment by any authority.
noQualification.p2: Tattooing people takes proper training, hygiene and safety education, and the licences your local law asks for. The trainer replaces none of that and gives no medical, health or safety advice.

account.title: Your account
account.p1: You need an account to save your work. Give accurate details, keep your password to yourself, and tell us if you think someone else has used your account. You can delete your account at any time in the Profile (Delete account).
account.p2: [Minimum age and parental consent rules — to be set by legal review.]

sketches.title: Your sketches and works
sketches.p1: You keep the rights to what you upload. By uploading a sketch you confirm that you own it or have the right to use it for practice, and that it does not infringe anyone else's rights or break the law.
sketches.p2: You allow us to store and process your sketches and works only to run the trainer for you: to show them back to you, make stencils from them and save your progress. We do not publish them or show them to other users.

rules.title: Acceptable use
rules.p1: Do not upload unlawful, hateful or infringing content, try to break or overload the service, or try to reach other people's data.

beta.title: Beta and availability
beta.p1: The trainer is in closed beta. It is provided as it is, features can change, and saved work can be lost despite our efforts to prevent it. Keep your own copy of anything you cannot afford to lose.

liability.title: Liability and governing law
liability.p1: [Limitation of liability and governing law — to be written by legal review.]

ending.title: Ending and changes
ending.p1: You can stop using the trainer or delete your account at any time. We may suspend accounts that break these terms. We may update these terms and will tell you about important changes in the app.

who.title: Who we are
who.p1: Tattoo Trainer is run by [OPERATOR NAME AND ADDRESS — to be filled in]. Questions and requests: {{email}}.

data.title: What we store
data.intro: We keep only what the trainer needs:
data.account: Account: your name, username, email address, experience level, language and settings (skin tone, machine speed, units, panel layout).
data.works: Works: the ink and skin-damage data of each work, a small preview image and its title.
data.sketches: Sketches: the image you upload and the stencil made from it.
data.sessions: Practice sessions: when you practised, the number of passes, the average deviation and the trauma level, and the statistics added up from them (sessions, hours, streak).
data.device: On your device: saved copies of your works so they open offline, your sign-in, your language and your cookie choice.
data.analytics: Analytics, only if you accept: which features are used (sign-ups, first stroke, stencil transfers, saves, end of a session) and basic device data, through Google Analytics cookies.

where.title: Where it is stored
where.p1: Account data, works, sketches and sessions are stored with Google Firebase (Authentication, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Storage) in the EU, in the europe-west3 region (Frankfurt). If you accept analytics, Google Analytics may process data outside the EU. [Transfers and safeguards — to be confirmed by legal review.]

why.title: Why we use it
why.p1: To provide the trainer (your account, saving, statistics) and, only with your consent, to understand and improve it. [Legal bases — to be confirmed by legal review.]

cookies.title: Analytics and cookies
cookies.p1: Analytics cookies stay off until you accept them in the banner. You can change your choice at any time in Profile → Analytics cookies, or with the cookie settings link in the footer. Refusing or withdrawing stops analytics and removes the cookies. The trainer does not use advertising cookies.

sharing.title: Who sees your data
sharing.p1: Only you can read your works, sketches and sessions. We do not sell your data. Google processes data for us as our hosting and analytics provider.

keep.title: Keeping and deleting
keep.p1: We keep your data while your account exists. Profile → Delete account removes your profile, works, sketches, sessions, username, stored files and your sign-in, and clears the copies on your device. [Backup retention and analytics retention periods — to be confirmed.]

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data, object to its use or withdraw consent, and complain to your data protection authority. Write to {{email}}; much of this you can do yourself in the Profile.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: We will update this page when something changes and tell you about important changes in the app.

cartridge.title: PICK A CARTRIDGE
cartridge.text: Liners (RL) draw outlines; shaders (RS) and magnums (M1, RM) fill and blend. Start with a liner for line work.

dip.title: DIP THE NEEDLE
dip.text: Choose an ink cap, then press DIP NEEDLE (Ctrl/⌘ + D). The needle only draws while it has ink, and it runs out as you work.

stencil.title: ADD A STENCIL
stencil.text: Upload a sketch in the Stencil panel, tune its lines, transfer it to the skin and place it. Then press APPLY STENCIL (or Enter) to lock it in place and start drawing.

draw.title: NOW DRAW
draw.text: Drag over the skin to tattoo. Move steadily: speed and passes change how the line looks, and the strip at the bottom scores your accuracy.
